verdict.rationale: GlitchTip ships an official, first-party glitchtip-cli with its own documentation page. The documented commands cover login, creating releases, recording deploys, associating commits, uploading source maps and debug files, and sending test events, configured through environment variables or a config file. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, evidence of agent-oriented features such as machine-readable output, and stable (non-Beta) status, since docs label it Beta.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Log in to your GlitchTip instance: glitchtip-cli --url https://your-glitchtip.example.com login
Upload debug symbols for native applications (dSYM, PDB, ELF): glitchtip-cli debug-files upload ./build --org my-org --project my-project
Send a test event to verify your setup: glitchtip-cli send-event -m "Test event from CLI"
Use the GlitchTip CLI (Beta) to inject debug IDs and upload source maps
